content.comment_body: I have a fan unit with a pressure switch (0-50Pa). I need to prove the switch is open circuit before starting the fan. After that, the pressure switch will control another device when the fan runs and stop it when the fan stops. I'm having trouble figuring this out. Any suggestions?
How does the signal connect to the [product_name]? Is it digital? Analog? 0-10V or 0/4-20mA?
Is it set up like this?
